title: Allergy Action Plan Registration Form
subtitle: An original operational registration for allergy action plan that connects identity, evidence, authority, exceptions, privacy, and accountable closeout.
description: This Allergy Action Plan Registration Form supports the complete allergy action plan workflow from intake and routing through evidence, authorized decisions, exception ownership, qualified review, and final handoff.
use_case: Use the Allergy Action Plan Registration Form when the assigned allergy-plan coordinator needs one fillable record for approved allergy plan, allergen controls, emergency supplies, response, and handoff without inventing legal, medical, safety, consent, certification, or professional authority.

sections.title: Allergy action plan registration identity and routing
sections.guidance: Connect this registration to one approved allergy plan, allergen controls, emergency supplies, response, and handoff record, an accountable owner, and the current review route.

sections.title: Allergy action plan registration intake and requested placement
sections.guidance: Capture one requested program assignment, schedule, and accountable enrollment route.

blocks.label: Allergy action plan registration information
items: Student and allergy action-plan reference
Guardian and qualified health-contact route
Allergens and exposure routes exactly as documented
Meal, snack, ingredient, classroom, and cross-contact controls
Symptoms and action sequence from the approved plan
Emergency medication, supplies, authorized staff, and backup coverage
School, program, transport, activity, and off-site applicability
Effective period, review date, update trigger, and record owner

blocks.label: Registration boundary
blocks.guidance: This form records an allergy action-plan workflow; it does not diagnose an allergy, interpret symptoms, invent exposure limits, or replace qualified directions or emergency services. Use only the current approved plan and authorization. Stop routine activity for any mismatch, suspected exposure, symptom, or unavailable control, protect privacy, and route response decisions to qualified authorized staff.

sections.title: Allergy action plan contacts, release route, and support readiness
sections.guidance: Route sensitive health and support information to its approved record and reviewer.

blocks.label: Registration readiness and stop conditions
items: Student identity, allergen, plan, or emergency supply does not match
Plan is missing, illegible, expired, changed, or unavailable
Food label, ingredient, meal, snack, or cross-contact control is unclear
Emergency medication, trained staff, or required setting is unavailable
Possible exposure, symptom, reaction, or administration event occurred
Classroom, transport, field trip, or activity environment changed
Immediate breathing, circulation, consciousness, or other emergency concern is active
Response, supply count, notification, or follow-up does not reconcile

blocks.label: Support or record source, applicability, owner, and status
Minimum-necessary information, access limits, assumptions, and open questions

fields.label: Information boundary, access limits, assumptions, and open questions

sections.title: Allergy action plan placement, readiness, and authorization decision
sections.guidance: Separate requested placement from authorized placement and retained conditions.

blocks.label: Allergy action plan readiness evidence
items: Allergy plan is tied to the correct student identity
Guardian and qualified plan sources are current
Allergens and exposure routes are copied from the approved plan
Meal, snack, classroom, transport, and activity controls are routed
Emergency medication and supply custody is confirmed
Symptoms, action sequence, and stop conditions come from the current plan
Authorized staff and backup response coverage are known
Emergency services and guardian contact routes are available
Privacy and minimum-necessary staff access are defined
Any mismatch, exposure, symptom, or missing control stops routine activity

blocks.label: Requested element, review result, condition, owner, and evidence
Allergy action plan registration decision
blocks.guidance: Record the authorized decision under current policy; this form does not grant authority to the preparer. Route uncertainty to the guardian, qualified health professional, and authorized allergy-response staff.

blocks.label: Placement rationale, alternatives, limits, and participant or guardian communication

sections.title: Allergy action plan onboarding, exceptions, and first-day handoff
sections.guidance: Turn each unresolved condition into an owned action before participation begins.

blocks.label: Registration exception indicators
items: Routine activity cannot proceed under the current allergy plan
Guardian authorization or qualified plan direction is incomplete
Student, allergen, plan, medication, or supply does not reconcile
Meal, activity, cross-contact, staffing, or setting control is unavailable
Possible exposure, symptom, reaction, or emergency response is active
Response, supply custody, notification, or follow-up remains unresolved

blocks.label: Condition, required action, owner, due point, and acceptance
Onboarding and first-day handoff
items: Authorized assignment and schedule communicated
Arrival, attendance, and departure routes visible
Guardian and emergency communication routes available
Approved health and support records routed privately
Open condition has an owner and due point
First review date and completion evidence identified

sections.title: Allergy action plan outcome, closeout, and accountable handoff
sections.guidance: Make the final outcome, remaining limitation, next action, owner, and recipient visible.

blocks.label: Allergy action plan closeout controls
items: Allergy-plan readiness and response status accepted
Guardian and qualified-review communication recorded
Unresolved exposure, control, or supply action has an owner
Emergency medication and equipment returned to approved custody
Meal, facility, health, or program follow-up linked
Allergy record stored with privacy and retention requirements
blocks.guidance: Check only completed controls; preserve unresolved work as an open action.

blocks.label: Outcome verification, recipient acceptance, and reopen decision
Remaining limitation, action, owner, due point, and recipient route
blocks.guidance: Keep unresolved work visible until an accountable recipient accepts it.

blocks.label: Unresolved work, child or participant impact, evidence location, and handoff message

fields.label: Unresolved work, impact, evidence location, and handoff message

blocks.label: Registration closeout acknowledgment
blocks.guidance: Acknowledgment records preparation and receipt; it is not legal consent, medical certification, or professional approval.
